verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a first-party CLI. `greptile onboard` handles org setup, repo connection and rules import, and `greptile review` reviews the branch diff. It is explicitly AI-native: `greptile review --agent` emits raw-text catches with suggested fixes for coding agents, and the onboarding page is meant to be handed to an agent to run. It also supports API-key auth for CI, and a probe confirmed the CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as described.
